## How Do I Know You Again?
Sometimes your Characters have a fully formed backstory in mind. Other times, you just want to build a connection between them with a single roll. The following is a list of 50 ways two or more Characters know each other. Furthermore, this list can be used to generate links between Characters and NPCs. Allow these prompts to inspire background elements, instead of changing a background to suit them, or reroll if the result is too outlandish for the situation. 

|**1d100**|**How Do I Know You Again?**|
|---|---|
|01–02|_We both served time in one of the Empire’s illustrious prisons._|
|03–04|_We used to be lovers, but the whims of Katya pulled us apart._|
|05–06|_We are distantly related, through a complex web of bloodlines better left unexamined._|
|07–08|_We are childhood friends, who grew up in the same rough neighbourhood._|
|09–10|_We were once going to be married, but the Rhyans refused to wed us, and we never learned why._|
|11–12|_We grew up in the same town, on the outskirts of the same monster-filled wilderness._|
|13–14|_We were rivals for the same position, and butted heads for years._|
|15–16|_We were rivals for the same paramour who was cruelly stolen from the world by the machinations of Morr._|

| 1d100 | How Do I Know You Again? |
|---|---|
| 17–18 | One of us was a previous victim of the other’s criminal ways, though, thank Ranald, that the victim doesn’t realise it! |
| 19–20 | One of us once betrayed the other, though by the grace of Sigmar, that past crime has been forgiven… or has it? |
| 21–22 | We served in the same conscripted militia, and learned to fear the howling of Ulric’s wolves together. |
| 23–24 | We were refugees together after a Greenskin attack on our duchy. |
| 25–26 | We met a long time ago, in a city on the other side of the Old World. |
| 27–28 | We were both victims of the same misfortune under Morrsleib’s pale-green glow. |
| 29–30 | We were both embroiled in a brawl together, somewhere on Altdorf ’s Street of a Thousand Taverns, and teamed up for mutual safety. |
| 31–32 | One of us was mistaken for someone else by the other, and lead on a series of curious events before anyone realised. |
| 33–34 | We met on the road, travelling in the same direction, and, ‘just got to talking’. |
| 35–36 | We were both framed by a Roadwarden for a crime we didn’t commit. |
| 37–38 | We were both sentenced to hang when our convoy was attacked by Beastmen and we escaped together. |
| 39–40 | One of us married the other’s widowed father or mother. |
| 41–42 | We were both sick and treated by the same Shallyan Order. |
| 43–44 | We grew up in the same Sigmarite congregation. |
| 45–46 | We were childhood sweethearts, until one of us had to leave home forever. |
| 47–48 | Our families have feuded for generations; indeed, our neighbours called our family disputes the, ‘Little Parravonese Wars’. |
| 49–50 | One of our father’s murdered the other’s in a vendetta worthy of a Tilean opera. |
| 51–52 | One of our families adopted the other when their family was burnt for witchcraft. |
| 53–54 | One of us caught the other red-handed picking their pocket. |
| 55–56 | We both attended a funeral in the Garden of Morr for a mutual friend. |
| 57–58 | Our mothers were old travelling companions, before they settled down to their respective families. |
| 59–60 | We both have siblings who were caught up in the same Chaos Cult. |
| 61–62 | Our siblings ran off together, causing a scandal in both families. |
| 63–64 | We share a merchant father who was juggling two families, kept secret from each other. |
| 65–66 | We were both caught during the same raid on a brothel, and had to explain how we were steadfastly not involved with the Chaos Cult discovered out back. |
| 67–68 | We used to be roommates in a filthy tenement building. |
| 69–70 | Somehow, our Doomings demanded we meet up, though we obviously keep them secret from each other. |

||**1d100**<br>**How Do I Know You Again?**<br>71–72<br>_We grew up in rivalling provinces, despite our villages being less than a mile from each other._<br>73–74<br>_We were once shipwrecked together, and had to spend an uncomfortable few months of the coast of Nordland._<br>75–76<br>_We were both onboard ships that were captured by Sartosan pirates, but managed to escape together._<br>77–78<br>_We both caught the same terrible disease many years ago, and were locked in quarantine together before it_<br>_mysteriously lifted._<br>79–80<br>_One of us turned up drunk on the other’s doorstep with the homeowner’s name tattooed on their arm.
